task.title: hermit: the guest gets no default route (`gateway=` is not a Hermit boot argument)
task.body:
For the `hermit` unikernel type, `pkg/unikontainers/unikernels/hermit_rs.go` builds the command line as `ip=<ip>/<prefix> gateway=<gw> [-- <args>]`. Hermit has no `gateway=` argument:

- Hermit's kernel on main reads the address and the gateway from one argument, `ip=<ip>/<prefix>:<gateway>` (`src/env/ip_config.rs`, since hermit-os/kernel f2f05350 of 2026-08-13). It logs `could not parse bootarg: gateway=<gw>` and configures the interface without a gateway.
- The latest Hermit release, v0.13.2, reads neither `ip=` nor `gateway=`. It takes `-ip <ip> -mask <mask> -gateway <gw>` (`src/env.rs`). This is from reading the code; I haven't run v0.13.2.
- No Hermit version has parsed `gateway=`.

To reproduce, I used urunc built with `make static` from 8355257, an echo server on Hermit main 0b8328c with hermit-loader v0.5.7 (the loader as `com.urunc.unikernel.binary`, the app as `com.urunc.unikernel.initrd`), QEMU, and nerdctl's default bridge. urunc runs:

```
qemu-system-x86_64 ... -kernel /cntrRootfs/unikernel/hermit-loader-x86_64-multiboot ... -initrd /cntrRootfs/unikernel/echo.elf -no-reboot -append "ip=10.4.0.3/24 gateway=10.4.0.1"
```

The guest logs:

```
[INFO  env       ] bootargs = /cntrRootfs/unikernel/hermit-loader-x86_64-multiboot ip=10.4.0.3/24 gateway=10.4.0.1
[ERROR env       ] could not parse bootarg: gateway=10.4.0.1
[INFO  device    ] IP address: 10.4.0.3/24
```

A client on the bridge (10.4.0.1) gets its echo. A client whose address is outside the guest's subnet (192.168.77.1 on the host's `lo`, so the reply has to go through the gateway) gets no reply.

The fix is to write `ip=<ip>/<prefix>:<gw>`, and `ip=<ip>/<prefix>` when there is no gateway. I'm working on a PR.

LLM usage: this issue was written with the help of Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`). I reviewed it, and the reproduction above was run before filing.
